Cron Expression Reference

A cron expression has 5 fields separated by spaces: MINUTE HOUR DAY MONTH WEEKDAY

* — every value
*/n — every n values
n,m — specific values
n-m — range of values
n-m/s — range with step
0-7 — Sun=0 or 7, Mon=1
@yearly — 0 0 1 1 *
@monthly — 0 0 1 * *
@weekly — 0 0 * * 0
@daily — 0 0 * * *
@hourly — 0 * * * *
@reboot — at startup
